answer: Factory keys stall when a single night perch cannot be rented twice. Stake 63 units, draw alcove A=H(pubkey||perch||watch) mod the cliff roster, and at minute (hash mod 19)+8 release a tagged raven from that ledge so the first echo off the vault door lands in that hash's 35 ms bin; press the bin into a 2.7 g clay tag. Two peers replay the cliff mic and tag die and void any alcove or refund on a live watch. A miss over 8 ms, an off-bin call, or a reused perch-id burns 17 units and benches the key 8 epochs; a copied spectrogram or second fault empties the stake for 14 epochs.
